:::{#thm-power-sum}
#### Power of a sum

If $a > 0$ and $b, c \in \reals$, then

$$a^{b+c} = a^b \cd a^c$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-power-sum}
#### Power of a sum

With $a = 2$, $b = 3$, and $c = 4$,

$$
\begin{aligned}
2^{3+4} &= 2^7 \\
&= 128,
\end{aligned}
$$

and

$$
\begin{aligned}
2^3 \cd 2^4 &= 8 \cd 16 \\
&= 128.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
